sources.title: Training Deliberative Monitors for Black-Box Scheming Detection
sources.snippet: In this work, we study action-only deliberative monitors: smaller open-weight models trained to detect scheming and sabotage from agentic trajectories without accessing the monitored agent's reasoning or model internals.
